title: KSB circles removed and camera capture rebuilt
details: Blank KSB circles are no longer created; only real learner, RPL, assessor or witness ticks are shown
The old KSB state watcher, v201 cleanup layer and duplicate completion watcher are no longer loaded
Photo review now appears immediately from the captured canvas while JPEG encoding finishes asynchronously
The existing evidence explanation, save flow, video flow, Maths, English and EPA tools remain available
summary: Evia v202 replaces the conflicting KSB marker patches and removes the visible wait after taking a photo.
changes: Replaced the old KSB marker system with one event-driven evidence-state layer
Removed empty marker slots instead of hiding them
Removed two whole-app MutationObserver layers from the active runtime
Shows the captured photo frame immediately instead of waiting for JPEG encoding before review
